thesis.primaryProblem: Website owners need to decide which Search, AI-search and agent-web improvements actually help a useful site become easier to find, use, cite and verify.
thesis.primaryAudience: Website owners and maintainers who can change a public site.
thesis.usefulOutcome: Choose a bounded evidence-backed improvement, implement it safely, verify the surface and measure the outcome separately.
thesis.distinctEvidence: Source-backed practices, explicit hypotheses, reproducible audits, Resolver observations, evidence receipts, experiments and dogfood on real sites.
thesis.primaryAction: Run a focused audit or choose the next evidence-backed change.

in: content usefulness, evidence and citation support
out: a proprietary manifest intended to replace native web standards

problemLanes.label: Be found
problemLanes.job: Help people, crawlers and agents reach the useful surface.

problemLanes.label: Be used
problemLanes.job: Make the answer clear, useful, attributable and machine-readable.

problemLanes.label: Be proven
problemLanes.job: Separate implementation checks from real outcome evidence.

routeRules.note: Primary product narrative and entry point.
Growth loop, hypotheses, experiments and outcome separation.
Research depth supports the product thesis without becoming a separate homepage identity.
Reference depth, not a first-order product lane.

notes: The four internal navigation destinations are the declared contract; the external GitHub link may remain a utility action without becoming another problem lane.
